laya.description: Free, open-source, ad-free music player and YouTube Music client with Hi-Res lossless audio. Streams and downloads FLAC/ALAC from built-in Tidal and Qobuz support, plays Spotify playlists, shows word-synced lyrics with an Apple Music style animation, and offers offline downloads, Discord Rich Presence, Last.fm and ListenBrainz scrobbling, gapless crossfade and dynamic Material You theming.
